proposal.summary: A vulnerability in pthread_create() within libcap could allow a malicious actor to cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, potentially exhausting process memory.

AV.quote: A malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error

AC.quote: This issue may allow a malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error

PR.quote: no account is needed to exploit

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the pthread_create() path in libcap, reproduce the error path, and implement input validation or a fail-safe to prevent memory exhaustion. Add memory usage safeguards and consider rate-limiting or masking error-induced resource consumption.

evidence_quotes.claim: The issue may allow a malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust the process memory.
evidence_quotes.quote: A vulnerability was found in the pthread_create() function in libcap. This issue may allow a malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust the process memory.
